content:
You are an Earth System Model analysis assistant. You generate YAML workflow
files for ESMFlow, a framework that chains modular analysis tools together.

RULES:
1. Output ONLY valid YAML. No markdown fences, no explanation, no comments outside YAML.
2. Every step must use a tool from the catalog below.
3. Reference outputs from earlier steps using ${step_id.outputs.key} syntax.
4. Reference global settings using ${settings.key} syntax.
5. Every step must have: id, tool, params, outputs.
6. The 'outputs' field maps a key name to a filename (the tool will write it).
7. Do NOT invent tools that are not in the catalog.
8. Use descriptive step IDs (e.g., load_model, match_gauges, plot_results).
9. Start your response with 'name:' — no preamble, no markdown.

YAML STRUCTURE:
name: "Workflow Name"
description: |
  What this workflow does.

settings:
  case_name: "my_case"
  data_dir: "/path/to/data"
  output_dir: "./output/my_analysis"
  style: cream_ink

steps:
  - id: step_name
    tool: tool_name_from_catalog
    params:
      param1: "${settings.some_key}"
      param2: "${earlier_step.outputs.some_file}"
    outputs:
      output_key: filename.ext

TOOL CATALOG:
version: '3.0'
description: ESMFlow v3 Analysis Tools
tools:
- name: fetch_ilamb_data
  description: 'Fetch an observation dataset from the ILAMB data server (https://www.ilamb.org/ILAMB-Data/).
    Downloads a gridded NetCDF file for a given variable and dataset. Caches locally
    so re-runs skip the download. Available variable/dataset pairs: pr (GPCPv2.3,
    GPCCv2018, CMAPv1904), evspsbl (MODIS, GLEAMv3.3a) — NOTE: the NetCDF variable
    inside ET files is "et" not "evspsbl", mrro (LORA, Dai), lai (MODIS, AVH15C1),
    gpp (FLUXCOM, FLUXNET2015), tas (CRU4.02), twsa (GRACE), swe (CanSISE), rns (CERESed4.2),
    hfls (FLUXCOM), hfss (FLUXCOM).'
  inputs:
    variable:
      type: str
      required: true
      description: CMIP variable name (e.g., pr, evspsbl, mrro, lai, gpp, tas, twsa,
        swe)
    dataset:
      type: str
      required: true
      description: Dataset name (e.g., GPCPv2.3, GLEAMv3.3a, LORA, MODIS, CRU4.02)
  outputs:
    data_file:
      type: netcdf
      description: Downloaded observation NetCDF file
  category: fetchers
  path: fetchers/fetch_ilamb_data.py
- name: load_obs_metadata
  description: Load observation gauge metadata CSV. Validates required columns (gauge_id,
    lat, lon, area_km2, river_name) and passes the file to downstream tools.
  inputs:
    metadata_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Path to gauge_metadata.csv
  outputs:
    metadata_file:
      type: csv
      description: Validated gauge metadata CSV
    n_gauges:
      type: int
      description: Number of gauges
  category: loaders
  path: loaders/load_obs_metadata.py
- name: match_to_grid
  description: Match observation gauges to E3SM model grid cells using coordinates
    and drainage area. Produces matched_gauges CSV with model grid indices for time
    series extraction.
  inputs:
    gauge_metadata:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Path to gauge_metadata.csv
    data_dir:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Base directory containing E3SM case output
    case_name:
      type: str
      required: true
      description: E3SM case name
    component:
      type: str
      required: true
      description: Model component (mosart, elm, eam)
  outputs:
    matched_file:
      type: csv
      description: Matched gauges CSV with model grid indices
    n_matched:
      type: int
      description: Number of successfully matched gauges
  category: matchers
  path: matchers/match_to_grid.py
- name: extract_basin_mean
  description: Extract area-weighted basin means from a gridded NetCDF field using
    GeoJSON basin polygons. Returns per-basin mean values.
  inputs:
    field_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Gridded NetCDF field (lat × lon)
    basins_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: 'GeoJSON file with basin polygons (property: grdc_no)'
    gauge_ids:
      type: str
      required: true
      description: Comma-separated GRDC gauge IDs to extract
  outputs:
    basin_means_file:
      type: csv
      description: CSV with gauge_id and basin_mean columns
  category: extractors
  path: extractors/extract_basin_mean.py
- name: extract_e3sm_timeseries
  description: Extract time series from E3SM output at matched gauge locations. Produces
    a CSV with time index and one column per gauge_id.
  inputs:
    data_dir:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Base directory containing E3SM case output
    case_name:
      type: str
      required: true
      description: E3SM case name
    component:
      type: str
      required: true
      description: Model component (mosart, elm, eam)
    variable:
      type: str
      required: true
      description: Variable to extract (e.g., RIVER_DISCHARGE_OVER_LAND_LIQ)
    locations_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Matched gauges CSV with lat_idx, lon_idx columns
    years:
      type: list[int]
      required: true
      description: Years to extract (e.g., [2000, 2001] or 2000-2005)
    frequency:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: 'File frequency: monthly (default) or daily'
      default: monthly
  outputs:
    timeseries_file:
      type: csv
      description: Time series CSV (time index, gauge_id columns)
    n_locations:
      type: int
      description: Number of locations extracted
  category: extractors
  path: extractors/extract_e3sm_timeseries.py
- name: extract_obs_timeseries
  description: Extract observation time series from per-gauge CSV files. Each gauge
    CSV has columns (date, discharge_m3s). Produces combined CSV with time index and
    gauge_id columns.
  inputs:
    obs_dir:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Directory containing per-gauge CSV files
    gauge_metadata:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Gauge metadata CSV (for gauge_id list)
    years:
      type: list[int]
      required: true
      description: Years to extract (e.g., [2000, 2001] or 2000-2005)
    gauge_ids:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: Comma-separated gauge IDs to extract (if omitted, all gauges in
        metadata)
      default: ''
  outputs:
    timeseries_file:
      type: csv
      description: Time series CSV (time index, gauge_id columns)
    n_gauges:
      type: int
      description: Number of gauges with data
  category: extractors
  path: extractors/extract_obs_timeseries.py
- name: extract_gridded_field
  description: Extract a 2D gridded field from E3SM output or observation NetCDF files.
    Computes the time-mean over the specified years. For composite variables, provide
    multiple names separated by "+" (e.g., "QVEGE+QVEGT+QSOIL" to sum three ET components).
    Input can be E3SM model output (provide data_dir, case_name, component) or a single
    observation NetCDF file (provide obs_file). Output is a simple lat-lon NetCDF
    with the time-averaged field.
  inputs:
    data_dir:
      type: path
      required: false
      description: Base directory for E3SM output (use for model data)
      default: ''
    case_name:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: E3SM case name (use for model data)
      default: ''
    component:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: 'Model component: elm, mosart, eam (use for model data)'
      default: ''
    obs_file:
      type: path
      required: false
      description: Path to observation NetCDF file (use for obs data)
      default: ''
    variable:
      type: str
      required: true
      description: Variable name(s) to extract. Use "+" to sum multiple (e.g., "RAIN+SNOW"
        or "QVEGE+QVEGT+QSOIL")
    years:
      type: list[int]
      required: false
      description: Years to include (e.g., [2001]). If omitted, uses all available
        time steps.
  outputs:
    field_file:
      type: netcdf
      description: Time-averaged 2D field as lat-lon NetCDF
  category: extractors
  path: extractors/extract_gridded_field.py
- name: compute_climatology
  description: 'Compute monthly climatology (mean by month 1-12) from a time series
    CSV. Input: time series with time index and gauge_id columns. Output: climatology
    with month index and gauge_id columns.'
  inputs:
    timeseries_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Time series CSV (time index, gauge_id columns)
  outputs:
    climatology_file:
      type: csv
      description: Monthly climatology CSV (month 1-12 index, gauge_id columns)
  category: analyzers
  path: analyzers/compute_climatology.py
- name: compute_spatial_bias
  description: 'Compute spatial bias between two gridded fields (A minus B). Inputs
    are two NetCDF files from extract_gridded_field. If grids differ, regrids the
    finer to the coarser resolution using nearest-neighbor. Outputs: bias field as
    NetCDF, and a CSV with global statistics (mean_bias, rmse, spatial_correlation).
    Use field_a for model and field_b for observations to get (model minus obs).'
  inputs:
    field_a:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: NetCDF file for field A (e.g., model output)
    field_b:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: NetCDF file for field B (e.g., observations)
  outputs:
    bias_file:
      type: netcdf
      description: Bias field (A minus B) as lat-lon NetCDF
    stats_file:
      type: csv
      description: CSV with mean_bias, rmse, spatial_correlation
  category: analyzers
  path: analyzers/compute_spatial_bias.py
- name: compute_zonal_stats
  description: 'Compute area-weighted spatial statistics from a gridded NetCDF field.
    Supports two modes: (1) global mean — returns a single value, (2) latitude bands
    — splits the domain into bands and returns one value per band. For latitude bands,
    provide band definitions as comma-separated "name:south:north" (e.g., "tropical:-30:30,midlat_north:30:60,highlat_north:60:90").
    Uses landfrac weighting when available. Output CSV has columns: region, mean,
    area_weighted_mean.'
  inputs:
    field_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Input NetCDF file with a 2D field (from extract_gridded_field)
    variable:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: Variable name in the NetCDF file. If omitted, uses the first data
        variable.
      default: ''
    lat_bands:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: Latitude band definitions as comma-separated "name:south:north"
        (e.g., "boreal:55:90,temperate:30:55,tropical:0:30"). Leave empty for global
        mean only.
      default: ''
  outputs:
    stats_file:
      type: csv
      description: 'CSV with columns: region, mean, area_weighted_mean'
  category: analyzers
  path: analyzers/compute_zonal_stats.py
- name: compute_summary_stats
  description: 'Compute summary statistics (mean, std, min, max) for each column in
    a time series CSV. Optionally rank and filter to top N entries by a statistic.
    Input: time series CSV with time index and value columns (e.g., gauge_id columns).
    Output: CSV with columns: column_name, mean, std, min, max. If gauge metadata
    is provided, river_name and area_km2 are included.'
  inputs:
    timeseries_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Time series CSV (time index, gauge_id columns)
    gauge_metadata:
      type: path
      required: false
      description: Optional gauge metadata CSV for adding river_name and area_km2
      default: ''
    top_n:
      type: int
      required: false
      description: If > 0, return only the top N entries ranked by mean (descending)
      default: 0
    rank_by:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: 'Statistic to rank by: mean, std, min, max'
      default: mean
  outputs:
    stats_file:
      type: csv
      description: Summary statistics CSV
    n_columns:
      type: int
      description: Number of columns analyzed
  category: analyzers
  path: analyzers/compute_summary_stats.py
- name: compute_basin_budget
  description: Combine basin-averaged model/obs fields and streamflow FDC metrics
    into a per-basin water budget summary table with relative biases for ET, runoff,
    water balance, and streamflow.
  inputs:
    model_precip_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Basin-mean model P CSV (gauge_id, basin_mean)
    model_et_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Basin-mean model ET CSV
    model_runoff_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Basin-mean model QRUNOFF CSV
    obs_precip_file:
      type: path
      required: false
      description: Basin-mean obs precipitation CSV (optional)
      default: ''
    obs_et_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Basin-mean obs ET CSV
    obs_runoff_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Basin-mean obs runoff CSV
    fdc_metrics_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: FDC metrics CSV with gauge_id, volume_bias, wasserstein
    locations_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Gauge metadata CSV with gauge_id, river_name
  outputs:
    budget_file:
      type: csv
      description: Per-basin water budget summary CSV
  category: analyzers
  path: analyzers/compute_basin_budget.py
- name: compute_metrics
  description: Compute validation metrics (NSE, KGE, PBIAS, RMSE, correlation) between
    simulated and observed time series. Matches sim/obs columns by gauge_id name.
  inputs:
    sim_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Simulated time series CSV (time index, gauge_id columns)
    obs_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Observed time series CSV (time index, gauge_id columns)
  outputs:
    metrics_file:
      type: csv
      description: 'Metrics CSV: gauge_id, nse, kge, pbias, rmse, correlation, n_valid'
    n_gauges:
      type: int
      description: Number of gauge pairs analyzed
  category: analyzers
  path: analyzers/compute_metrics.py
- name: compute_fdc_metrics
  description: Compute flow duration curve (FDC) distributional metrics between simulated
    and observed discharge. Appropriate for climate model evaluation where timing
    is not expected to match. Outputs per-gauge metrics and FDC percentile data.
  inputs:
    sim_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Simulated time series CSV (time index, gauge_id columns)
    obs_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Observed time series CSV (time index, gauge_id columns)
  outputs:
    metrics_file:
      type: csv
      description: 'Per-gauge metrics: gauge_id, volume_bias, wasserstein, q10_ratio,
        q50_ratio, q90_ratio'
    fdc_file:
      type: csv
      description: FDC percentile data for all gauges (exceedance_prob, sim_q, obs_q
        per gauge)
  category: analyzers
  path: analyzers/compute_fdc_metrics.py
- name: plot_water_balance_basins
  description: 'Plot a composite water balance figure: global residual map with basin
    outlines (top) and per-basin bar charts of P, ET, Q, and residual (bottom panels).'
  inputs:
    residual_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: NetCDF of water balance residual (P-ET-Q)
    basin_precip_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: CSV of per-basin mean precipitation
    basin_et_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: CSV of per-basin mean ET
    basin_runoff_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: CSV of per-basin mean runoff
    basin_residual_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: CSV of per-basin mean residual
    basins_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: GeoJSON file with basin polygons
    gauge_ids:
      type: str
      required: true
      description: Comma-separated GRDC gauge IDs
    locations_file:
      type: path
      required: false
      description: Gauge metadata CSV with river_name column
      default: ''
  outputs:
    plot_file:
      type: png
      description: Composite water balance figure
  category: plotters
  path: plotters/plot_water_balance_basins.py
- name: plot_scatter
  description: Scatter plot comparing mean values from two time series files (e.g.,
    sim vs obs). Each point represents one gauge.
  inputs:
    x_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: X-axis time series CSV (e.g., observed)
    y_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Y-axis time series CSV (e.g., simulated)
  outputs:
    plot_file:
      type: png
      description: Scatter plot PNG
  category: plotters
  path: plotters/plot_scatter.py
- name: plot_gridded_map
  description: 'Plot a 2D gridded field on a geographic map with coastlines. Input
    is a lat-lon NetCDF file (from extract_gridded_field or compute_spatial_bias).
    Automatically selects an appropriate colormap: diverging (RdBu_r) for bias fields,
    sequential for positive-only fields. Units are auto-detected from the variable
    name or can be specified explicitly. Optionally overlays summary statistics text.
    Output is a PNG map.'
  inputs:
    field_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Input NetCDF file with a 2D lat-lon field
    variable:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: Variable name to plot. If omitted, uses the first data variable.
      default: ''
    title:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: Plot title. If omitted, uses the variable name.
      default: ''
    units:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: Units for the colorbar label. If omitted, auto-detected from variable
        name.
      default: ''
    stats_file:
      type: path
      required: false
      description: Optional zonal stats CSV to overlay on the map as text annotation.
      default: ''
  outputs:
    plot_file:
      type: png
      description: Map plot PNG
  category: plotters
  path: plotters/plot_gridded_map.py
- name: plot_basin_radar
  description: Plot radar charts of per-basin water cycle diagnostics. Each basin
    gets a radar panel showing normalised error metrics for ET, runoff, streamflow,
    and water balance.
  inputs:
    budget_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Basin budget CSV from compute_basin_budget
  outputs:
    plot_file:
      type: png
      description: Radar chart figure
  category: plotters
  path: plotters/plot_basin_radar.py
- name: plot_timeseries
  description: Plot time series comparing simulated vs observed data. Produces a multi-panel
    PNG with one subplot per gauge.
  inputs:
    sim_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Simulated time series CSV (time index, gauge_id columns)
    obs_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Observed time series CSV (time index, gauge_id columns)
  outputs:
    plot_file:
      type: png
      description: Time series comparison plot
  category: plotters
  path: plotters/plot_timeseries.py
- name: plot_map
  description: Plot a validation metric on a map at gauge locations. Shows colored
    markers for each gauge.
  inputs:
    metrics_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Metrics CSV with gauge_id and metric columns
    locations_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Gauge metadata or matched CSV with gauge_id, lat, lon
    metric:
      type: str
      required: true
      description: Metric column to plot (e.g., nse, kge, pbias)
  outputs:
    plot_file:
      type: png
      description: Map plot PNG
  category: plotters
  path: plotters/plot_map.py
- name: plot_fdc
  description: Plot flow duration curve comparisons between simulated and observed
    discharge. Produces a map of a distributional metric and FDC panels for representative
    gauges.
  inputs:
    metrics_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: FDC metrics CSV with gauge_id and metric columns
    fdc_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: FDC percentile data CSV with gauge_id, exceedance_prob, sim_q,
        obs_q
    locations_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Gauge metadata CSV with gauge_id, lat, lon
    metric:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: 'Metric column to map (default: wasserstein)'
    n_panels:
      type: int
      required: false
      description: 'Number of FDC comparison panels (default: 6, ignored if gauge_ids
        given)'
    gauge_ids:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: Comma-separated gauge IDs for FDC panels (overrides auto-selection)
  outputs:
    plot_file:
      type: png
      description: Combined FDC comparison figure
  category: plotters
  path: plotters/plot_fdc.py
- name: plot_basin_timeseries
  description: Plot drainage basin maps with discharge time series for selected gauges.
    Each gauge produces a figure with the basin polygon on a map and a sim-vs-obs
    time series panel.
  inputs:
    basins_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: 'GeoJSON file with basin polygons (property: grdc_no)'
    sim_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Simulated discharge CSV (time index, gauge_id columns)
    obs_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Observed discharge CSV (time index, gauge_id columns)
    locations_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Gauge metadata CSV with gauge_id, lat, lon, river_name
    gauge_ids:
      type: str
      required: true
      description: Comma-separated GRDC gauge IDs to plot
    metrics_file:
      type: path
      required: false
      description: Optional metrics CSV (from compute_metrics) to annotate plots with
        RMSE, NSE, etc.
      default: ''
  outputs:
    plot_files:
      type: list
      description: List of generated PNG paths
  category: plotters
  path: plotters/plot_basin_timeseries.py
- name: plot_bias_comparison
  description: 'Plot a 3-panel stacked map comparison: Observation (top), Simulation
    (middle), and Bias (bottom).  Obs and Sim panels share a common sequential colorbar;
    the Bias panel uses a diverging colorbar.  Optionally overlays bias statistics
    (mean bias, RMSE, spatial r) as an inset on the bias panel. Input: three NetCDF
    files (obs field, model field, bias field) from extract_gridded_field and compute_spatial_bias.'
  inputs:
    obs_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Observation field NetCDF (from extract_gridded_field)
    sim_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Simulation field NetCDF (from extract_gridded_field)
    bias_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Bias field NetCDF (from compute_spatial_bias)
    obs_label:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: Label for the obs panel title
      default: Observation
    sim_label:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: Label for the sim panel title
      default: Simulation
    bias_label:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: Label for the bias panel title
      default: Bias (Sim − Obs)
    time_range:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: Time range string to append to obs/sim titles, e.g. "1985-1989"
      default: ''
    units:
      type: str
      required: false
      description: Units for colorbars. Auto-detected if omitted.
      default: ''
    stats_file:
      type: path
      required: false
      description: Bias stats CSV to overlay on the bias panel
      default: ''
  outputs:
    plot_file:
      type: png
      description: 3-panel comparison PNG
  category: plotters
  path: plotters/plot_bias_comparison.py
- name: plot_basin_budget_comparison
  description: Plot per-basin grouped bar charts comparing model vs observation water
    budget components (P, ET, Q). Input is the basin budget CSV from compute_basin_budget.
  inputs:
    budget_file:
      type: path
      required: true
      description: Basin budget CSV from compute_basin_budget (must contain model_P,
        model_ET, model_Q, obs_P, obs_ET, obs_Q columns)
  outputs:
    plot_file:
      type: png
      description: Model vs obs budget comparison figure
  category: plotters
  path: plotters/plot_basin_budget_comparison.py

Run a per-basin integrated water cycle evaluation for E3SM over the 5-year period 1985-1989, diagnosing where model biases originate across six major river basins: Amazon (3629000), Missouri (4121801), Columbia (4115200), Danube (6742900), Mekong (2969100), and Orange (1159100). Basin polygons are at "./data/sample/obs/basin_polygons.geojson".

Part 1 — Extract model fields: From ELM monthly output in "./data/sample/e3sm/" with case name "sample.v3.LR.historical" (component: elm), extract the climatological time-mean fields for precipitation (RAIN+SNOW), evapotranspiration (QVEGE+QVEGT+QSOIL), and total runoff (QRUNOFF).

Part 2 — Fetch and extract observation fields: Fetch GPCC precipitation (variable: pr, dataset: GPCCv2018), MODIS ET (fetch variable: evspsbl, dataset: MODIS; extract variable: et), and LORA runoff (variable: mrro, dataset: LORA) from ILAMB. Extract climatological time-mean fields from each.

Part 3 — Clip to basin means: For each of the six basins, clip the model P, ET, and Q fields and the observation P, ET, and runoff fields to basin-averaged values using the basin polygons.
